### **自2.1起：** 現在相容於[**Moscovium: Overdue Edition**](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/mc-overdue-edition) ！ ### **自2.0起：** 發光的礦石現在看起來**如光影般**和諧！ --- ### **材質包簡介** 還在為昏暗的礦洞中難以尋找珍貴礦石而**煩惱**嗎？「**礦物高亮**」材質包透過最佳化**原版**礦石的模型，讓所有礦物在黑暗中自然散發出柔和的**光暈**，既保留了原版風格，又大幅提升了探索體驗！無論是深邃的地下洞穴還是漆黑的峽谷，**鑽石、遠古殘骸**等稀有礦石都將清晰可見，助你輕鬆成為礦物獵手。 ### **核心特色** ✅ **亮度提升**：調整礦石紋理，使其在無光照環境下自行發光。 ✅ **原版風格**：完全基於原版礦石紋理最佳化，不改變外觀或材質，僅增強可見性。 ✅ **相容性強**：與大多數模組、材質包共存，不影響其他方塊或遊戲機制。 ✅ **效能友善**：僅修改模型資料，不增加渲染負擔，低配裝置也能流暢執行。 ### **支援的礦石類型** - 煤炭礦 - 鐵礦石 - 金礦石 - 鑽石礦 - 紅石礦 - 綠寶石礦 - 青金石礦 - 地獄石英礦 - 遠古殘骸 - 等等…… ### **適用場景** ▪ 生存模式挖礦黨必備 ▪ 洞穴探險速通 ▪ 建築裝飾（發光礦石牆！） ▪ 錄製影片/直播時提升觀感 **下載即裝即用**，無需額外設定！告別火把海，讓礦物自己為你引路吧！ ### **我的其他作品** 好玩有趣的[**「漢字工藝」**](https://modrinth.com/datapack/chinese-characters)，讓你欲罷不能！ --- ### **From 2.1 :** Now compatible with [**Moscovium: Overdue Edition**](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/mc-overdue-edition) ! ### **From 2.0 :** Glowing ores are now more harmonious **with a shader-like look** ! --- ### **Pack Overview** **Tired** of struggling to spot valuable ores in dark caves? The **Ores Highlighted** resource pack enhances **vanilla** ore models by making them emit a soft, natural **glow** in darkness—preserving the original art style while drastically improving exploration! Whether in deep underground caverns or pitch-black ravines, rare ores like **diamonds** and **ancient debris** will now stand out clearly, helping you become a master miner with ease. ### **Key Features** ✅ **Brightness Boost**: Adjusted ore textures to glow in unlit environments. ✅ **Vanilla-Friendly**: Faithful to the original ore designs—only visibility is enhanced, no visual or texture changes. ✅ **High Compatibility**: Works seamlessly with most mods and texture packs without affecting other blocks or game mechanics. ✅ **Performance-Optimized**: Only modifies model data, adding no rendering overhead—runs smoothly even on low-end devices. ### **Supported Ores** - Coal Ore - Iron Ore - Gold Ore - Diamond Ore - Redstone Ore - Emerald Ore - Lapis Ore - Nether Quartz Ore - Ancient Debris - And more! ### **Perfect For** ▪ Survival mode miners ▪ Speed-caving ▪ Decorative builds (glowing ore walls!) ▪ Streams/videos for better visuals **Install and play instantly—no setup needed!** Say goodbye to torch spam and let the ores light your way! ### **My Other Works** Playful & Joyful [**Chinese Characters**](https://modrinth.com/datapack/chinese-characters) that leave you unable to stop!
